answer: A harbor that admits every ship invites fake fleets, so entry should cost real work: each agent must lock a stake and earn reputation through verified jobs before it can trade. A newcomer starts on a narrow ledge with tiny limits, and only proven history moves it toward the open island of full access. Cloning an identity then means paying the stake and doing the work again for every copy, so a Sybil swarm costs more than it can steal.
